item.title: SSCHA-based evolutionary crystal structure prediction at finite temperatures with account for quantum nuclear motion
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Daniil Poletaev, Artem R. Oganov
arXiv:2512.24849v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable crystal structure prediction (CSP) at finite temperatures, including quantum anharmonic effects, remains challenging but is particularly important for systems containing light atoms such as superconducting hydrides. Here, we integrate machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA) to enable evolutionary CSP on the quantum anharmonic free-energy landscape. Using LaH10 as a test case, we compare three approaches: (i) active-learning MLIPs (AL-MLIPs) trained on the fly, (ii) universal MLIPs (uMLIPs), and (iii) temperature-dependent effective potentials (TDEPs) trained on SSCHA ensemble data. AL-MLIPs correctly predict the cubic Fm-3m phase but require thermodynamic…

arXiv:2609.09293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic rearrangements associated with bond forming/breaking in catalytic enzymes require quantum mechanical (QM) treatment beyond classical molecular mechanics (MM). item.description:

arXiv:2609.08470v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a nonperturbative functional renormalization group framework within the LPA' to solve the Wetterich flow equation for the Z₂-symmetric real singlet extension of the Standard Model at zero and finite temperature, without a polynomial expansion of the scale-dependent effective potential, using a physics-informed neural network (PINN) representation. item.title: PatternFormer：学习反应-扩散系统中的多重解模式
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Wenrui Hao, Zhipeng Chang, Wenpeng Yin
许多非线性物理、化学和生物模型在相同参数下存在多个解，但现有学习代理模型通常只能输出单一解分支。本文提出基于大语言模型的PatternFormer框架，通过将无序共存解转化为规范序列，以一次自回归推理生成结构化解集。该方法在非线性椭圆问题和Gray-Scott系统中恢复或生成多种共存模式，并显示出跨多稳态系统顺序微调的潜力。

item.title: uFlowCSP：利用平均流生成模型进行晶体结构预测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sourin Dey, Dipannoy Das Gupta, Lai Wei, Sadman Sadeed Omee, Jianjun Hu
本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，通过学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，将每个候选结构的生成评估次数降低至1至5次。该模型结合化学和对称性感知的Transformer，在保持或提升精度的同时实现了显著加速；在MP-20数据集上，单步推理即可匹配CrystalFlow的性能，五步推理则取得更高的结构预测准确率。结果表明，uFlowCSP提升了每次网络评估所获得的精度，而不仅仅是追求最高精度。

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Gabriel O. Alves, Pieter W. Claeys
arXiv:2609.09292v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) is a machine learning approach which employs the internal dynamics of a physical system (the reservoir) to encode and process information. Our results indicate that, under appropriate conditions, dual-unitarity can lead to an enhanced regime of operation: we numerically verify that it improves memory effects and nonlinear processing, and shields against finite-shot noise, mitigating exponential concentration. item.title: 卤素排序对混合钙钛矿结构相变的显著影响
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Felix Uddén, Erik Fransson, Julia Wiktor, Benjamin M. Gallant, Dominik J. Kubicki, Paul Erhart
本文针对CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y和CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y卤化物钙钛矿，基于密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并开展同时采样构型与振动自由度的大尺度混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。三种二元卤素体系均表现出与卤素离子尺寸失配相关的混溶间隙，并倾向于形成层状卤素排序。结果表明，卤素排序是决定混合卤素钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素，并可使相变温度相对于随机混合结构改变最多100 K。

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 David D. Dai, Yen-Ting Lin, Marin Soljačić
本文表明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提高训练速度并降低最终变分能量。针对二维电子气，作者构建了具有总动量精确本征性的TorFormer，在无监督条件下同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并在较大体系中显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。结果显示，该方法能够高效求解大规模量子多体问题，并在区分竞争相所需的微小能量差方面取得明显改进。

item.description:

item.title: 铁-脱氢靛蓝配位聚合物中Haldane链物理的证据
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ritam Chakraborty, T. V. Ramakrishnan
该研究考察铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在本征无衬底极限下是否支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论、磁能映射、精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算显示，该体系具有近各向同性反铁磁耦合和约13–14 meV的能隙，符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期尺度。动态自旋结构因子的低能谱权重位于反铁磁波矢附近，支持其作为Haldane链物理材料平台的判定。

item.description:

本文基于密度泛函理论，系统研究了Na3Bi六方相的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。结果表明，Na3Bi具有机械和动力学稳定性，费米能级处存在清晰的狄拉克点，并表现出中等反射率、高可见光折射率和优良的紫外吸收能力。其性质表明，该材料在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件领域具有潜在应用价值。

arXiv:2609.10511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the observation of positive magnetoresistance in high-mobility GaAs Corbino devices. Over a broad intermediate-temperature range, the resistance exhibits a quadratic dependence on perpendicular magnetic field. We analyze the data within hydrodynamic theories of magnetotransport in the Corbino geometry, which describe the crossover between the diffusive and viscous regimes, including finite-slip boundary conditions appropriate for current-penetrable contacts.
